title: Egyptian basics
about: The commonest words of everyday Egyptian Arabic that are not Modern Standard Arabic, most common first, 50 to a unit. Counted in 7.4 million words of real Egyptian text (TV subtitles, novels and songs, newspaper readers’ comments, forum posts); every word passes the no-MSA rules (not in the MSA basics list or the 1,000 commonest Arabic words, not an MSA word said differently or with dialect endings, not given with the same meaning in Standard Arabic dictionaries), and every meaning is backed by a published dictionary. Each word has one short everyday Cairo sentence with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word. Words that only look like an MSA word carry a note.
